mailboxes.description: List of mailboxes to check for mail. Each item must specify type and server-specific fields depending on type.

mailboxes.items.type.description: Mailbox protocol: pop3, imap4, mh, maildir, or mbox

mailboxes.items.server.description: Mail server hostname or IP address (for pop3/imap4)

mailboxes.items.pass.description: Password for authentication (insecure; consider external tools like gnome-keyring)

mailboxes.items.port.description: Port number (110 for POP3, 143 for IMAP4)

sort_by_date.description: Sort messages by date instead of arrival order

play_sound.description: Play a sound when new mail arrives

sound_file.description: Path to sound file to play

mail_reader.description: Command or program to open/read messages

spam_header.description: Email header to inspect for spam status

system_tray.description: Show icon in system tray (requires desktop environment support)
